title: Water in Braud's tuba
summary: The band poured two buckets of water down Braud's tuba, and Bigard, sitting beneath him, got drenched when Duke made him play it.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So Wellman Braud, bless his soul, he had a tuba and his bass violin, but he couldn't play tuba. He didn't know the first thing about a tuba but he's trying to make notes for with the tuba. So we took -- when he was off the stage, we took two buckets of water and poured it down the tuba, and I forgot, I was sitting underneath him, see. So we told Duke to play a tune that he had to pick up that tuba and Duke did. And, boy, he grabbed that tuba and he started blowing and drowned me, --
So that's what they used to do, see, like we used --
